messages:
Alex W: Quick sync — product/marketing asked for a single checklist we can hand to Snow/DBX/SI for the field demo + marketplace listing. Who can own collating the security certs + embargo timeline?
Priya S: I can start a checklist. Need to confirm whether Snow requires an internal security attestation or just our ATO docs.
Tom B: From DBX side: we need the packaging artifact (wheel + docker) and the auth shim sample. Also need the connector performance matrix for the one-hour demo.
Elena R: Partner asks that press embargo is 72 hours before public listing. We should align press + marketplace publish windows.
Alex W: Good point. Can we put together a 3-column table: (owner, artifact/check, deadline relative to launch) and assign owners?
Priya S: I'll draft. Quick stub:
- Security docs: owner=Priya, due=-14d
- Packaging artifact (docker + helm): owner=Tom, due=-10d
- QA test matrix + perf numbers: owner=Tom, due=-7d
- Field demo manifest (sample dataset + runbook): owner=Elena, due=-5d
- Marketplace listing assets (icons, blurb, pricing): owner=Alex, due=-3d
- Press embargo coordination: owner=Elena, due=-3d
Alex W: partner_bot, can you attach the partner workspace link and the current cert checklist?
partner_bot: Attached: https://partners.redwood.ai/workspaces/snow-dbx-qdrant (permissions granted to @partnerships). Also uploaded current SOC2 summary and recent pentest link.
Tom B: For the packaging artifact: recommend we include a lightweight sidecar example for vector DB auth. Example snippet for helm values we will supply:
```
vectorConnector:
  image: redwood/vector-connector:v1.3.0
  sidecar:
    enabled: true
    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: "500m"
        memory: "512Mi"
```
Elena R: Also flag for the legal team: Snow wants a co-branded statement for the marketplace tile. I can loop in legal once we have final copy.
Priya S: One more ask: Databricks wants a short security FAQ for their listing portal — two bullets max: data residency + key management. I'll draft and ping legal.
Alex W: Can we agree next steps: Priya will post the checklist doc in the partner workspace by EOD tomorrow; Tom will upload a test image and perf numbers by Friday; Elena will confirm embargo window with partner PR and update the timeline. I'll own the marketplace copy and coordinate legal.
Tom B: Ack. I'll also add a simple script for local dev: `scripts/run_local_demo.sh` and link it in the runbook.
Elena R: ETA: PR confirm by Thursday PST. If press embargo needs to move, we'll call a go/no-go 48h before.
Priya S: Checklist link posted: https://partners.redwood.ai/checklists/snow-dbx-field-demo (draft). Please comment inline.
Alex W: Nice. Last ask — can someone add a short rollback play for the marketplace listing (simple steps to unpublish + patch)? We need that for the release war room.
Tom B: I'll add rollback steps to the release checklist.
Elena R: Thanks team — syncing live tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Alex W: Thanks — see you tomorrow.
